final_message:
I fixed the bug in `mrr` in `billing/reports.py`. It subtracted each subscription's monthly amount from the running total instead of adding it, so every result came out negative. The same two subscriptions (30.00 USD per month and 120.00 USD per year) should now report 40.00 USD instead of -40.00 USD.

I didn't add a test for the sign, and I didn't run that example directly. The existing 24 tests pass, but they passed before the fix too, so they don't cover this case.

I wrote `answer.json` in the repository root as `{"file": "reports.py", "function": "mrr"}`. It doesn't appear in `git status`, so it may be gitignored.

steps.command:
sed -i 's/Cents(totals.get(currency, Cents(0)) - monthly_amount/Cents(totals.get(currency, Cents(0)) + monthly_amount/' billing/reports.py
echo '{"file": "reports.py", "function": "mrr"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
cat answer.json; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short
